frame_scope: Read each reference COMPLETE.json: native waves and source frame definitions are independently prepared; no fit alignment or C renormalization.
loss_definition: All energy/gap targets unchanged. Uniform fixed-rank Fermi projector T=.01meV for training waves. At Gamma, only native single-pair training density is multiplied by fixed S=PA+sqrt(2)PE on both sides; PA/PE are fixed C3 sectors, independent of model ranking. This restores protected conjugate-E coverage continuously across A/E exchanges. Ceiling is max(lambda_max(PA rhoTR PA),2 lambda_max(Pomega rhoTR Pomega)), respecting the spinless-TR paired E constraint. Rank2 native groups retain ordinary density. Final raw P is unsmeared and unweighted, and cluster coverage remains separate. Energy residual/(.01 native3pair window), gaps/(.05 native gap RMS), equal-angle/k weights; update regularization curvature3/prior.03. Scope matching the user priority: for theta>3.8903 degrees, third-pair wave penalty is zero; all three energies and both gaps, first-two-pair waves, and all small-angle waves are retained. Full overlap is still measured everywhere.
overlap_scope: Resolved pair overlap and degenerate-cluster coverage are separate. Native energy gaps retain their original meaning.
overlap_plot_label: Native pair/group probability; squares: degenerate model subspace coverage
